# HandleMyFile - Complete Platform & API Architecture Guide (LLMS-Full)

> HandleMyFile (https://handlemyfile.com) is an enterprise-grade, 100% Client-Side WebAssembly (WASM) document manipulation and conversion suite.
> Unlike legacy web services (e.g. Smallpdf, iLovePDF, Adobe Acrobat Online) that upload sensitive user files to remote servers, HandleMyFile executes all cryptographic, parsing, rasterization, and conversion operations strictly inside the client's web browser RAM using compiled C++/Rust WebAssembly modules and Web Workers.

## Key Security Guarantees
1. **Zero Server Uploads**: No user document ever traverses the network. The backend has 0 document endpoints.
2. **RAM-Only Lifecycle**: Files are processed in ephemeral browser memory and immediately garbage collected upon tab close or task completion.
3. **Unhackable Architecture**: Because data never resides on a server, data breaches, man-in-the-middle interceptions, and server-side ransomware are mathematically impossible.
4. **GDPR, HIPAA & CCPA Compliant**: Processing occurs on the data subject's device, satisfying strict international data sovereignty requirements.

## Complete Catalog of 49 Tools
- **Merge PDF** (`/merge-pdf`): Merge multiple PDFs into one unified document with custom ordering.
- **Split PDF** (`/split-pdf`): Extract specific pages or split by page ranges.
- **Compress PDF** (`/compress-pdf`): Reduce file size locally using WebAssembly deflate algorithms with selectable quality profiles.
- **Edit PDF** (`/edit-pdf`): Add text, shapes, annotations, and canvas drawings directly to pages.
- **OCR PDF** (`/ocr-pdf`): Extract searchable text from scanned PDFs and photos using Tesseract.js WebAssembly.
- **Watermark PDF** (`/watermark-pdf`): Apply text or image watermarks with 9-position anchor points and repeating diagonal tile matrices.
- **Sign PDF** (`/sign-pdf`): Draw, upload, or generate cryptographic digital signatures.
- **Protect PDF** (`/protect-pdf`): Encrypt PDFs with AES-128/256 standard passwords directly in browser memory.
- **Unlock PDF** (`/unlock-pdf`): Decrypt password-protected PDFs locally without uploading passwords.
- **Redact PDF** (`/redact-pdf`): Permanently redact and sanitize sensitive PII and confidential terms from PDF streams.
- **Rotate PDF** (`/rotate-pdf`): Reorient pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- **Crop PDF** (`/crop-pdf`): Trim page margins visually with exact millimeter coordinates.
- **Organize PDF** (`/organize-pdf`): Reorder, delete, and duplicate pages interactively.
- **Page Numbers** (`/page-numbers`): Add dynamic pagination headers and footers with custom formats and fonts.
- **Grayscale PDF** (`/grayscale-pdf`): Convert full-color documents to monochrome black and white for ink savings.
- **Remove Metadata** (`/remove-metadata`): Strip EXIF, author, camera, and software tracking metadata from PDF and image headers.
- **Compare PDF** (`/compare-pdf`): Side-by-side visual difference highlighting using pixelmatch WebAssembly.
- **Reverse PDF** (`/reverse-pdf`): Reverse page order from back to front with 1 click.
- **Resize PDF** (`/resize-pdf`): Scale documents between standard formats (A4, Letter, Legal, A3, Tabloid).
- **Scan to PDF** (`/scan-to-pdf`): Capture webcam or document scanner inputs directly into searchable PDFs.
- **Extract Images** (`/extract-images`): Extract embedded JPEG, PNG, and WebP graphics from PDF streams.
- **Word to PDF** (`/word-to-pdf`): Convert DOCX files to PDF using local canvas rasterization.
- **Excel to PDF** (`/excel-to-pdf`): Convert XLSX and CSV spreadsheets into formatted PDFs.
- **PPT to PDF** (`/ppt-to-pdf`): Convert presentation slides into PDF slide decks.
- **TXT to PDF** (`/txt-to-pdf`): Convert plain text files into clean, paginated PDF documents.
- **Image to PDF** (`/image-to-pdf`): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP files into multi-page PDFs.
- **PDF to Word** (`/pdf-to-word`): High-precision reconstruction of PDF text and layout into editable DOCX.
- **PDF to PPT** (`/pdf-to-ppt`): Convert PDF pages into editable PowerPoint slides.
- **PDF to Image** (`/pdf-to-image`): Render PDF pages to high-resolution PNG, JPG, or WebP.
- **CSV to Excel** (`/csv-to-excel`): Convert raw CSV text data into styled Microsoft Excel XLSX workbooks.
- **Excel to CSV** (`/excel-to-csv`): Export Excel sheets to standard RFC 4180 CSV strings.

## Global Multi-Language Support
HandleMyFile is available in 30 languages with native localized URLs and reciprocal hreflang tags:
English (en), Indonesian (id), Spanish (es), French (fr), German (de), Japanese (ja), Portuguese (pt), Russian (ru), Chinese (zh), Arabic (ar), Hindi (hi), Italian (it), Korean (ko), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Turkish (tr), Vietnamese (vi), Thai (th), Czech (cs), Greek (el), Hungarian (hu), Romanian (ro), Swedish (sv), Danish (da), Finnish (fi), Norwegian (no), Slovak (sk), Ukrainian (uk), Hebrew (he), Malay (ms).
